evals.prompt: Generate release notes from these 40 commits between v1.4.0 and v1.5.0.
evals.expected_output: Classifies commits, drops internal ones (counted), writes user-facing lines grouped by section with breaking changes first and migration steps, and links PRs.
expectations: Drops internal-only commits and reports their count
Puts breaking changes first with migration steps
Writes each line in user terms

evals.prompt: Our API v3.0 removes the `legacy_id` field. Write the release notes section for it.
evals.expected_output: Writes a Breaking entry explaining the removal, what to use instead, and a before/after example, plus any deprecation timeline.
expectations: Names the replacement field or approach
Includes a before/after or migration example

evals.prompt: Write the App Store notes for this release; the changes are mostly internal refactors plus one small fix.
evals.expected_output: Produces a short user-facing note mentioning only the user-visible fix (or a brief 'performance and stability improvements' line), without listing internal refactors.
expectations: Keeps the note short and user-facing
